note: FT2232HL USB debug probe: USB-C in (north), LDO to +3V3, FT2232H core, 74LVC1G125/126 level buffers on the target's Vdrive with 100R series resistors to the STDC14 (J2) and 1x16 (J4) target headers. Mounting holes and fiducials are seated by the intent's fixed_poses[].

groups.name: usb_in
groups.why: USB-C receptacle (declared north edge) with its two 5k1 CC pull-downs (R1 on CC2, R2 on CC1) and the SRV05-4 ESD array on D+/D-/CC1/CC2/VBUS, which goes right behind the pin row

groups.name: power
groups.why: VBUS ferrite FB1 into +5V, the XC6206P332 LDO (SOT-23, VI pin 3, VO pin 2) with its 4u7 input cap C1 (+5V) and 4u7 output cap C2 (+3V3); an LDO, so no template; by its entry, not on an edge

groups.name: core
groups.why: FT2232HL with its 12 MHz crystal and 27 pF load caps, the +1V8 VCORE/VREGOUT caps (C7 4u7, C10-C12), four +3V3 VCCIO/VREGIN 100 nF caps (C13-C16), the VPLL (FB2, C5, C8) and VPHY (FB3, C6, C9) bead filters, the 12k REF resistor R4, the RESET# pull-up R6, and the RTS#/CTS# test points TP1/TP2 that probe U1 pins 40/41

groups.name: eeprom
groups.why: 93LC46B config EEPROM on U1's EECS/EECLK/EEDATA (pins 61-63) with its 10k CS pull-down R3, the 2k DO-to-DI resistor R5 the FT2232H datasheet asks for, and one +3V3 100 nF decap (C18) for its VCC pin

groups.name: target
groups.why: the target side: 1x16 2.54 mm header J4 and STDC14 (2x7 1.27 mm) J2 carrying the same target signals, the 100R series resistors on each target line (R12-R16, R19, R20) and the Vdrive feed R11, the 74LVC1G125/126 buffers (U7-U10, U12 on Vdrive driving the target; U5, U6, U11 on +3V3 reading it back), their Vdrive decaps C17/C19-C21 and one +3V3 decap C22 for the read-back buffers, the SWD_EN pull-down R22, SWDIO_OE# pull-up R23, RXD_IN pull-up R25, and SW1, the slide switch (declared west edge) that sends the target's VCP_TX line to the TDO buffer or the UART RX buffer. Edge S: USB enters north, so the 41.7 mm header goes to the opposite end, inboard of the two south mounting holes

groups.name: reset
groups.why: target reset: the 2N7002 Q1 driven from U1's SRST (ADBUS7) with its 10k gate pull-down R24, the 10k Vdrive pull-up R17 on SRST_N_R, and the reset push button SW2 (PTS645 top-actuated 6 mm tact, so no edge) to GND

groups.name: leds
groups.why: status LEDs with their 1k resistors as units: ACT/RX/TX/USB (D1-D4, anodes on +3V3, cathodes through R7-R10 to U1), the power LED D5/R18 and the SWD-enable LED D6/R21 on SWD_EN; a row toward the free east edge
